status: UNVALIDATED — every numeric value in this file is a hypothesis. See v2/HYPOTHESES.md.

reference_community_authority.name: Ecological Vegetation Classes (DEECA Victoria)
reference_community_authority.note: Registry ledger is not EVC-dependent; EVC supplies indigenous species authority and strata expectations only.

_comment_pillar_caps: H-001 — PLACEHOLDER. These MUST be wired to the actual v1 constants in js/reg-score.js before any shadow run is treated as meaningful. Do not calibrate against these numbers.
_comment_lai: H-010 — growth-form Leaf Area Index proxies. Placeholder values loosely shaped by the NParks LAI guidebook logic but NOT taken from it and NOT validated for temperate Victorian species. Requires a measured or literature-derived table before EC is published in any form.
_comment_provenance: H-011 — indigenous weighting. Ordinal direction is defensible; the magnitudes are not yet.
_comment_strata: H-012 — structural diversity multiplier by count of distinct occupied strata.
_comment_persist: H-013 — persistence factor. Starting value by substrate permanence; earned upward by verified longitudinal survival. Applies to EC ONLY, never to EP.
_comment_network: H-014 — network multiplier. Hard-bounded. Requires >=3 verified members before any uplift applies.
_comment_envelope_class: H-020 — class derivation thresholds. Display labels only; never load-bearing in EP or EC.
_comment_richness: H-030 — envelope-scaled indigenous species richness target. Floor is non-negotiable: below it a site is not habitat at any scale.
_comment_strata_targets: H-031 — the retargeting table. This is the core of the model: which stratum counts as this envelope's 'upper stratum'. Requires ecologist review, not developer judgement.
_comment_applicability_floor: H-040 — pillar cap penalty when too much of a pillar's weight is inapplicable.
_comment_nonwaivable: H-041 — indicators with applicability 1 on EVERY site, no exception. Failure imposes a hard EP ceiling.
_comment_soil: H-050 — soil function. Genuinely zero on a sealed slab. This is intentional and belongs in EC, not EP.
_comment_water: H-051 — water function. Never zero: a fauna water point is available to every envelope including a balcony.
_comment_habitat: H-052 — discrete habitat features, diminishing returns applied as ecu * count^0.6.
_comment_ecu_scale: H-060 — the ECU unit itself is arbitrary until anchored. Anchor candidate: 1 ECU = the effective indigenous leaf-area volume of one mature indigenous shrub in good condition. Not yet fixed.
